name: Azure OAuth Client SSO
description: Login to a Drupal site through Microsoft Azure Active Directory / Entra ID.
project_description: Azure OAuth Client SSO lets people sign in to a Drupal site with a Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory) account using the OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow against login.microsoftonline.com. An administrator supplies the Azure application's tenant ID, client ID and client secret; the module builds the authorize redirect, exchanges the returned code for tokens at the /oauth2/v2.0/token endpoint, and reads the signed-in person's profile from Microsoft Graph (https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me). A matching Drupal account (by email) is logged in, or a new account is provisioned. Configuration screens let you map Microsoft Graph properties onto Drupal user fields, map Entra directory groups or the department field onto Drupal roles, optionally sync the profile photo, and choose between an immediate redirect to Microsoft or a login button rendered on selected forms. The access and refresh tokens are stored on the user entity and can be retrieved from the azure_oauth_sso.token_service service.
